sections.title: WAEC & NECO Chief Examiner Rubric Coaching

blocks.v: Most students lose marks not from lack of knowledge, but due to technical violations of the WAEC Marking Scheme. Our scholars are coached directly on Chief Examiner grading templates to retain every fractional point.
2005 - 2024 Past Question Marathon
Full 20-year archival access with step-by-step model solutions formulated specifically by vetted certified WAEC & NECO markers.
Step-Marking Breakdown
WAEC awards M (Method), A (Accuracy), and B (Independent) marks. Omitting the standard algebraic sequence yields immediate 0 even if the final numerical answer is correct.
Unit Omission Docks
Failure to append correct S.I. units (e.g., $N/m^2$, $ms^{-1}$) at the final step docks 1 full mark per question, resulting in cumulative grade degradation across Section B.
Essay Structural Strictness
Rigid adherence to Content, Organization, Expression, and Mechanical Accuracy (COEM). Formal letters with punctuation flaws in recipient addresses are immediately penalized.
Diagram Magnification
Diagrams must use clean un-feathered lines, clear label guidelines without arrowheads, explicit magnification titles ($\times 1.5$ to $\times 2.0$), and proportional accuracy.

admissions.h1: Admissions Processing & CAPS Guidance: Coaching Until Matriculation
admissions.lead: High JAMB scores alone don't guarantee admission. Our strategic admissions counseling navigates Post-UTME screening, JAMB CAPS marketplace transfers, catchment area quotas, and O-Level subject blending so you never lose your deserved seat.

blocks.v: UNILAG, LASU, UI, OAU, FUTA departmental quota qualifiers.

sections.title: The 5 Hidden Pitfalls That Disqualify 270+ JAMB Candidates

blocks.v: Every admission cycle in Lagos State, thousands of ambitious scholars score well above 250 in the UTME yet end up without admission. The shortfall is rarely academic capacity—it is procedural and regulatory disqualification.
Catchment & Federal Quota Misalignment

Federal universities distribute admissions via: 45% National Merit , 35% Catchment Area , and 20% Educationally Less Developed States (ELDS) . Applying to institutions like UNILORIN or UNIBEN as an applicant from Lagos/Ogun without hitting pure national merit thresholds immediately surrenders your slot to local catchment candidates.
Subject Combination Nuances

Faculty requirements differ subtly across institutions. For instance, UNILAG Accounting strictly rejects Commerce in place of Economics, while LASU permits particular commercial substitutions. A candidate scoring 290 with the wrong 4-subject combination faces immediate automated disqualification.
Ignored JAMB CAPS Marketplace

When candidates miss the departmental cutoff, universities often transfer them into allied courses via the CAPS marketplace. You have a strict 72 to 120-hour window to review and accept transfer proposals. Ignoring or misinterpreting this portal action results in permanent forfeiture.
O-Level Blending & Sitting Penalties

Blending WAEC and NECO is widely permitted, but premier faculties (e.g. UNILAG College of Medicine) strictly mandate ONE sitting with 5 distinctions. Combining sittings without assessing individual school weighting deduction equations leads to sudden rejection at the physical clearance phase.
Underestimating Aggregate Formulas

Different institutions execute radically distinct composite weighting metrics: UNILAG uses 50% UTME + 30% Post-UTME CBT + 20% O-Level; LASU executes a pure 50:50 O-level point system alongside UTME score. Misunderstanding this causes candidates to falsely overestimate their competitive footing.
From initial score appraisal to the moment your clearance dossier is stamped at the academic affairs office, we actively govern every stage of the admissions pipeline.
Brochure & Realistic Target Institution Matching

We analyze the candidate's exact raw score against 5-year historic departmental cut-offs. If a 248 is insufficient for Pharmacy at UNILAG, we execute a rapid, data-backed institutional reassignment to institutions where that score guarantees a merit-list position.
School-Specific Post-UTME Mock CBT Drills

We run tailored computer-based screening drills mirroring individual university test patterns: UNILAG’s 30-minute 40-question speed endurance; OAU’s specialized Aptitude Test; and UI’s strict departmental problem sets at our Banana Estate lab.
Daily JAMB CAPS Central Monitoring

Admissions officers update candidates at irregular hours. Our academic planning desk conducts daily status tracking: from "Not Admitted" to "Recommended", "Approved", and "Accepted", verifying that your O-level upload was never silently dropped by JAMB system syncs.
Remedial Action & Program Transfer Advisory

If primary departmental cutoffs shift upward due to anomalous national scores, we trigger immediate program transfer strategies within the same institution or transition the candidate into accredited Direct Entry (JUPEB) pipelines to prevent sitting out a gap year.
Final Clearance & Matriculation Follow-Through

Our contract does not end at CAPS acceptance. We assist with screening document dossiers (original JAMB admission letter, attestation letters, local government identification certificates, clinic medical screenings) until matriculation number assignment.
